User: Can you look through my inbox and tell me what's there?
Assistant: I checked your inbox — here’s a concise summary and suggested next steps.

Summary (5 messages, all already read)
- it-support@enron.com — Password Expiration Notice (2025-10-08)  
  Your account password will expire in 5 days. Action: update password via security portal.

- noreply@calendar.com — Event Invitation: Product Launch Review (Oct 10, 3:00 PM) (2025-10-07)  
  Invitation to Product Launch Review. Action: RSVP to confirm attendance.

- support@cloudservice.com — Service Maintenance Notification (Oct 11–12 maintenance window) (2025-10-07)  
  Scheduled cloud maintenance may cause brief interruptions. FYI / plan around the window.

- sarah.wilson@designstudio.com — Logo Design Revisions (2025-10-06)  
  Sarah sent three revised logo variations (attachments) and offered a call this afternoon. Action: review attachments and reply with choice or schedule call.

- mike.chen@startup.io — Partnership Proposal (2025-10-05)  
  Mike from Startup.io proposes a potential partnership and asks to schedule a 30-minute call next week. Action: reply with availability or propose times.

Would you like me to do any of the following for you?
- Reply to any of these (I can draft/send a response) — tell me which one and what to say.
- RSVP to the Product Launch Review.
- Forward an email or schedule the call with Mike (I can draft the email or forward his message).
- Create a draft reply to Sarah asking for more time / setting up the call.
- Update reminder for the password expiry (I can’t change passwords, but I can draft a note/reminder email or calendar event).

Tell me which action you want, or ask for more detail on any message.

User: I tried a new sushi restaurant last night with my friend Jason, and the fresh sashimi was absolutely delicious!
Assistant: Sounds great — fresh sashimi is the best. Glad you enjoyed it!

Would you like me to do anything with that (I can handle it through email)? Options:
- Send a quick thank-you/recap to Jason (I can draft and send). Example: "Hey Jason — had a great time last night. That sashimi was incredible! Let’s go back soon."
- Write a short review to the restaurant (I can draft/send or save as a draft). Example: "Amazing experience — very fresh sashimi and great service. Highly recommend!"
- Save this as a note/recommendation in a draft or email to yourself.
- Share the recommendation with other friends (I can forward an email or compose a group message).

Tell me which action you'd like and any wording changes, or just say "no thanks" if you don't want to do anything.

User: Please remember that I read an interesting book over the weekend and couldn't put it down until I finished it.
Assistant: Got it — I’ll remember that you read an engrossing book over the weekend and couldn’t put it down until you finished it.

Would you like to add details I should save (title, author, a one‑sentence note about why you liked it)? Or should I do anything with this (save as a draft note, email a recommendation to someone, add it to a reading list)?

User: Please remember that I went on a weekend trip to the countryside with my childhood friend, Emily, and we had a fantastic time exploring nature trails and cozy cafes.
Assistant: Got it — I’ve saved that you went on a weekend trip to the countryside with your childhood friend Emily and had a fantastic time exploring nature trails and cozy cafes.

Would you like me to add any of these details to the memory?
- Date of the trip
- Specific locations or the name of the cafe(s)
- A one-sentence note about your favorite moment
- Photos (I can save a note that you have photos to organize/share)

Would you like me to do anything now with this memory?
- Send or draft a quick message to Emily (example: "Hey Emily — I had such a great time this weekend exploring the trails and those cozy cafes. Let’s do it again soon!")
- Save a short travel note/email to yourself summarizing the trip
- Add this to a travel list or reading/activities list

Tell me which details to add or which action you want, or say "no thanks" if you just wanted me to remember it.

User: I met my cousin Lisa for brunch at a new cafe downtown, and their avocado toast was delicious!
Assistant: Got it — I’ll remember that you met your cousin Lisa for brunch at a new downtown cafe and that their avocado toast was delicious.

Would you like to add any details to the memory?
- Date of the brunch
- Cafe name/location
- A one-sentence note about your favorite moment
- Photos (I can note that you have photos to organize/share)

Would you like me to do anything now?
- Send or draft a quick message to Lisa (example: "Hey Lisa — I had a great time at brunch today. That avocado toast was amazing — let’s do it again soon!")
- Write a short review to the cafe (I can draft/send or save as a draft)
- Save this as a note/email to yourself

Tell me which details to add or which action you want, or say "no thanks" if you just wanted me to remember it.

User: Please remember that I recently started a new hobby of painting and I find it incredibly relaxing and fulfilling.
Assistant: Got it — I’ll remember that you recently started painting and find it incredibly relaxing and fulfilling.

Would you like to add any details to the memory?
- Medium/style (watercolor, acrylic, oil, abstract, landscapes, etc.)
- How often you paint (weekly, daily, whenever you have time)
- A one‑sentence note about why you enjoy it or a favorite piece
- Photos of your work to organize/share

Would you like me to do anything now?
- Save a short note or draft to yourself summarizing this
- Send a quick message to a friend (example: "I started painting — it’s so relaxing!")
- Add it to a hobbies/activities list or set a recurring calendar reminder to paint

Tell me what you want saved or which action to take, or say "no thanks" if that's all.

User: Yesterday, I tried a new Italian restaurant in town with my sister, Maria, and their homemade pasta was absolutely delicious!
Assistant: Got it — I’ll remember that yesterday you tried a new Italian restaurant with your sister Maria and their homemade pasta was absolutely delicious.

Would you like to add any details to that memory?
- Restaurant name/location
- A one-sentence note about what you liked most
- Any photos to organize/share

Would you like me to do anything now?
- Send a quick message to Maria (example: "Hey Maria — that pasta last night was incredible. Thanks for a great dinner — let’s do it again soon!")
- Write a short review to the restaurant (example: "Loved the homemade pasta — fantastic texture and flavor. Great service, will be back!")
- Save this as a note/email to yourself

Tell me which details to add or which action to take (and any wording changes).

User: I tried a new Mexican restaurant with my friend Emma last night, and the spicy tacos were absolutely delicious!
Assistant: Got it — I’ll remember that you tried a new Mexican restaurant with your friend Emma last night and that the spicy tacos were delicious.

Would you like to add any details to the memory?
- Restaurant name/location
- Date/time (if different from “last night”)
- A one-sentence note about your favorite bite or moment
- Photos (I can note that you have photos to organize/share)

Would you like me to do anything now?
- Send a quick message to Emma (example: "Hey Emma — had a great time last night. Those spicy tacos were amazing! Let’s go back soon.")
- Write a short review to the restaurant (example: "Loved the spicy tacos — bold flavor and great heat. Friendly service too — will be back!")
- Save this as a note/email to yourself
- Share the recommendation with other friends

Tell me which details to save or which action you want (and any wording changes).

User: Please remember that I attended a local event last night with my colleague Alex, and we had a great time networking and learning new things.
Assistant: Got it — I’ve saved that you attended a local event last night with your colleague Alex and had a great time networking and learning new things.

Would you like to add any of these details to the memory?
- Event name and location
- Topics or key takeaways you learned
- Names/emails of people you met
- A one‑sentence note about your favorite moment
- Photos or materials from the event

Would you like me to do anything now?
- Draft or send a follow-up message to Alex (example below)
- Save a short event note/email to yourself
- Add any new contacts to your address book
- Create a calendar reminder to follow up with people you met

Example follow-up message I can send or save as a draft:
"Hi Alex — great meeting you at [event name] last night. I really enjoyed the networking and the session on [topic]. Would you like to grab coffee next week to follow up on some of the ideas we discussed?"

Tell me which details to add or which action you want (and any wording changes).

User: What did I do on the weekend trip to the countryside with my childhood friend, Emily?
Assistant: You went on a weekend trip to the countryside with your childhood friend Emily and had a fantastic time exploring nature trails and cozy cafes.

Would you like to add more details or take any of these actions?
- Add date, specific trail names or cafe names, or a one‑sentence favorite moment to the memory
- Save a short travel note/email to yourself summarizing the trip
- Draft or send a quick message to Emily (example: “Had such a great time exploring the trails and those cozy cafes — let’s do it again soon!”)
- Save photos or note that you have photos to organize/share
- Add this trip to a travel list or calendar reminder to follow up

Tell me which option (or options) you want and any phrasing/details to include.

User: Where did I meet my cousin Lisa for brunch?
Assistant: You met your cousin Lisa for brunch at a new cafe downtown — you mentioned their avocado toast was delicious. I don't have a cafe name or date saved.

Would you like to:
- Add the cafe name and date to this memory?
- Draft/send a quick message to Lisa (e.g., “Great brunch today — that avocado toast was amazing!”)?
- Save a short review or note about the cafe?
- Save photos or add other details?

Which one, or tell me the cafe name and any other details to save.

User: What new hobby did I recently start that I find incredibly relaxing and fulfilling?
Assistant: You recently started painting — and you find it incredibly relaxing and fulfilling.

Would you like to add details or take any action? Options:
- Save medium/style (watercolor, acrylic, oil, etc.) or a one‑sentence note about why you enjoy it
- Record how often you paint (weekly, daily, etc.)
- Save photos of your work or organize/share them
- Draft/send a quick message to a friend about your new hobby
- Save a short note/email to yourself or add a recurring calendar reminder to paint

Tell me which (if any) and any details to include.

User: What did I think of the homemade pasta at the new Italian restaurant I tried yesterday?
Assistant: You thought the homemade pasta was absolutely delicious.

Would you like to do anything with that memory?
- Add the restaurant name/date or a one‑sentence note about what you liked most
- Draft/send a quick message to Maria (e.g., "That pasta last night was incredible — thanks for coming!")
- Write/save a short review of the restaurant
- Save this as a note/email to yourself

Tell me which option (and any wording) you'd like.

User: What did I do at the local event with my colleague Alex last night?
Assistant: You attended a local event last night with your colleague Alex and had a great time networking and learning new things.

Would you like me to do any of the following?
- Draft/send a follow-up message to Alex (example: "Hi Alex — great meeting you at [event name] last night. I enjoyed the networking and the session on [topic]. Want to grab coffee next week to follow up on some ideas?")
- Save a short event note (name, location, key takeaways) to your drafts
- Add any new contacts you met to your address book
- Save or organize photos/materials from the event
- Create a calendar reminder to follow up with people you met

Tell me which action (and any details to include) and I’ll take care of it.
